g.text: Ingest, Fan Out, Deliver -- Isolated Per Subscriber
One (event, subscription) row per match -- a claim against one subscriber's queue can never see, let alone block, another's.
Every arrow after the Fan-Out Writer is scoped to ONE (event, subscription) row --
a worker claiming Subscriber B's overdue retry can't see, let alone block, a claim against Subscriber A's row.
The Retry Scheduler and Dead-Letter State are just two different terminal outcomes for that SAME row -- never a separate delivery.
